extraction: santa-method batch sampling: instead of reviewing every output, sample batches (e.g., 30% of engine outputs get dual review). If sample passes, rest auto-approved. Risk: weak cells (Santali, Kashmiri) might be missed in sample. Mitigation: stratified sampling — always review weak cell outputs. Maps to our campaign: with 18 engines, full dual review = 36 reviews. Batch sampling could reduce to ~12. But campaign small — full review preferred for evidence quality.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether santa-method batch sampling used or full dual review per engine
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
